sql: SELECT ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN hit_and_run_i='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) FROM crashes WHERE date(crash_date)='2026-07-01'

SELECT cc.category, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.crash_type='INJURY AND / OR TOW DUE TO CRASH' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)/COUNT(*) AS rate FROM crashes c JOIN contributory_causes cc ON c.prim_contributory_cause=cc.cause GROUP BY cc.category ORDER BY rate DESC, cc.category

SELECT street_name, ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN hit_and_run_i='Y' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*),2) AS hit_and_run_pct FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name HAVING COUNT(*)>=2 ORDER BY hit_and_run_pct DESC, street_name
WITH s AS (SELECT street_name, SUM(injuries_total) t FROM crashes GROUP BY street_name) SELECT street_name, t FROM s WHERE t > (SELECT AVG(t) FROM s) ORDER BY t DESC, street_name
